wv-city-wards.summary: This app draws Charleston's wards and not those of Huntington, Parkersburg or Wheeling, so in those three cities it cannot say which ward or council district you live in.
wv-city-wards.why: No map file of the three cities' wards has been found, and the Census Bureau does not map city wards.
wv-city-wards.wanted: Each city's current ward map as a map file, such as a shapefile, or a pointer to where the city publishes one.

wv-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City, Town or Village card names the place you picked, and not its mayor or council. Only Charleston's council is named, on the City Council Ward card.
wv-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of West Virginia's city and town officials has been read, and of the cities' own pages only Charleston's council page has been read so far.
wv-municipal-officeholders.wanted: Each city's, town's and village's own published list of its mayor and council, or one statewide list of them.

wv-school-board-members.summary: The County card names the county commission and the county's other elected officers, and not the members of the county board of education.
wv-school-board-members.why: The state's latest list of county officials is from before the boards changed in July, and this app has not yet read who won the May election instead.
wv-school-board-members.wanted: Nothing from a reader. The certified results of the May primary name every board, and reading them is ours to do.

wv-voting-precincts.summary: This app does not draw West Virginia's voting precincts yet, so it cannot say which precinct you vote in.
wv-voting-precincts.why: The state's precinct map was last changed four years ago, and it matches the counties' own spring election results in only 29 of the 55 counties, so the rest may be out of date.
wv-voting-precincts.wanted: Each county's current precinct map as a map file, or a statewide precinct map that the state keeps current.
